description: Pure enrichment module exposing compute_score(metadata) that returns (float, dict). Uses registry_source, age_days, download_count, dependency_count, publisher_verified, stars. Reads MULTIPLE metadata fields for strong discrimination. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Will be exercised by enrichment_harness.py and gated by enrichment_evidence.sql before integration. This is the 6th of 8 required signal enrichments; community_signal currently has 34 distinct values with room for improvement.
